feature_title: IAM MCP Server for All Editions

rationale.edition: All 25 changed file paths are under web/src/ — a purely OSS tree. No paths under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ appear. While the MCP Server was historically enterprise-gated, this change explicitly removes that gating: it lifts the route registration out of the config.isEnterprise conditional in useEnterpriseRoutes.ts, removes the enterprise-guard spread in useIngestionRoutes.ts, drops ai_enabled gating from Recommended.vue, removes the enterprise 'visible' gate from IdentityAccessManagement.vue, and strips the enterpriseNote locale string from all 14 language files. The code is being intentionally moved to OSS.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. No explicit opt-out label or comment was provided (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty). The change is user-facing — it alters the IAM view to show the MCP Server card on all editions, adds the MCP tab to the ingestion Recommended workflow unconditionally, and changes the McpServerCard to toggle between OAuth and token auth modes based on edition build flags.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change modifies three user-facing UI surfaces: (1) the IdentityAccessManagement IAM page now renders the MCP Server card unconditionally for OSS builds, (2) the ingestion Recommended.vue tab list includes an MCP cross-link unconditionally, and (3) the McpServerCard now hides the OAuth auth-mode tab on OSS builds and defaults to token mode. A tester must verify that OSS builds show the correct auth mode (token only), that the MCP setup card is navigable from IAM, and that the ingestion-to-IAM cross-link works end-to-end.
rationale.area: GeneralTests — the IAM/MCP feature does not map to Logs, Metrics, Traces, Dashboards, or other stream-type areas. The GeneralTests shard in the CI matrix already includes IAM-adjacent specs like serviceAccount.spec.js, making it the best home. No dedicated IAM test folder exists in the matrix.
rationale.group: GeneralTests — chosen because the ci_matrix_env.json GeneralTests shard hosts cross-cutting specs (sanity, enrichment, schema, serviceAccount, theme-management, etc.) that match the IAM admin-surface nature of this feature. The MCP Server setup page is an IAM sub-page alongside Service Accounts, and the matrix groups it closest to the existing serviceAccount spec.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The changed *spec.ts files (Recommended.spec.ts, useEnterpriseRoutes.spec.ts, useIngestionRoutes.spec.ts, IdentityAccessManagement.spec.ts) are all Vitest unit tests under web/src/, not Playwright E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. They cover component-level logic (tab lists, route counts, visible items) but do not provide end-to-end browser coverage of the MCP Server UI flow.
